intent: A GitHub sign-in that fails returns the person to the app with a stated reason instead of a raw API page.
actor: A person signing in with GitHub
observable_outcome: Every callback failure redirects to the app address with a login_error code the app turns into a sentence; an outage and a refused credential stay distinguishable.

acceptance_criteria.statement: GitHub rate limiting, server errors and transport failures redirect with login_error=github_unavailable; other GitHub refusals redirect with github_refused.
A callback whose state does not match the state cookie redirects with login_error=expired before any code exchange.
